github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Use xUnit for C# tests, Jest/Vitest for TypeScript, pytest for Python. Follow AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert). Include edge cases.

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: Review for security (OWASP Top 10), performance (N+1 queries, async misuse), maintainability (SRP, DRY), and test coverage.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use Conventional Commits format: type(scope): description. Types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore, perf, ci.
